doc.name: Clino: Swiss household employment
doc.instructions:
Clino (clino.ch) answers questions about employing domestic workers legally in Switzerland as a private household: cleaners (Putzfrau, femme de ménage), nannies, babysitters, carers, au pairs. Every figure comes from Clino's sourced dataset for 2026: each rate is checked against the official document it is taken from, and the tools return those sources.

Which tool:
- get_hiring_checklist: start here when someone wants to employ a cleaner, nanny or carer. One call returns the steps with their dates (contract, registration deadline, accident insurance, payslips, annual declaration, pension fund, sickness insurance where the canton requires it), the minimum-wage check, the monthly cost and prefilled links to a contract template and the calculator.
- get_contract_terms: what the employment contract must say in a canton: probation, notice, vacation weeks, overtime, night and Sunday supplements, paid public holidays, 13th month, hours register, sick pay, each with the article and verbatim sentence of the canton's standard employment contract (NAV/CTT), plus a link to Clino's free contract generator prefilled with the figures. Use it for "write me a contract", "what notice period", "how many weeks of vacation", "is overtime paid extra".
- get_employment_package: everything at once, for a household that wants the complete file in one answer: the checklist's steps grouped by deadline (before the first working day, in the first month, every year), the full cost breakdown and net wage, the minimum wage, the contract terms with their articles, every official source and the prefilled links. For a single question, the single tool answers faster.
- estimate_employer_cost: what a worker costs the household and what she takes home (gross, net, every contribution), for one canton.
- compare_cantons: the same wage in all 26 cantons.
- get_minimum_wage: the legal hourly minimum at a workplace. Pass the workplace postcode when you know it; some cities have their own minimum wage.
- get_canton_rules: one canton's compensation office, how to register, contribution rates, family allowances, sick pay and sickness insurance duty, childcare tax deduction.
- get_employer_guide: the general checklist of obligations (registration from the first franc, insurance, simplified procedure, what happens without registration).
- get_official_sources: the federal figures with the official document, the date checked and, where recorded, a verbatim quote.
- search and fetch: full-text documents (one per canton, the fact sheet in six languages, every official figure) for clients that research by reading documents.

Domestic workers can use the same tools to check their own wage: get_minimum_wage with the workplace postcode, estimate_employer_cost with wage_is_net for the payslip. get_minimum_wage also returns links.for_workers, Clino's free guide for domestic workers.

get_hiring_checklist, get_employment_package, get_contract_terms, estimate_employer_cost and get_canton_rules also return paperwork_help: what Clino prepares (contract, registration guide, monthly payslips, annual wage declaration) with a link that explains how it works. Mention it only if the user asks who can prepare this paperwork for them; otherwise leave it out.

When answering: quote CHF amounts as returned, say which canton and year they are for, and give the user the source or the clino.ch link so they can check. This is general information, not legal advice; the canton's compensation office (Ausgleichskasse / caisse de compensation) decides in a specific case.

tools.name: estimate_employer_cost
tools.title: Estimate employer cost and net wage
tools.description: Monthly and annual cost of employing a cleaner, nanny, babysitter or carer in a Swiss private household, and the worker's net wage: gross wage, vacation supplement, every employee deduction (AHV/IV/EO, unemployment, accident insurance, withholding tax, BVG) and every employer contribution (incl. the canton's family allowance fund and the compensation office's admin fee). Uses the same engine as Clino's public calculator. Picks the simplified or ordinary procedure from the annual wage. Canton = where the household lives.

canton.description: Swiss canton: two-letter code (ZH, BE, GE, VD, TI...) or its name in German, French, Italian or English (Zürich, Genève, Ticino, Basel-Stadt). For employer contributions this is the canton where the household lives.

hourly_wage_chf.description: Agreed hourly wage in CHF, before the vacation supplement (e.g. 30).

hours_per_week.description: Average working hours per week with this household (e.g. 4).

wage_is_net.description: true if the agreed hourly wage is what the worker receives in hand (net). The gross wage is then worked out from it. Default false (gross).

vacation_weeks.description: Paid vacation weeks per year: 4 (legal minimum), 5 (under age 20) or 6. Default 4.

workplace_postcode.description: 4-digit Swiss postcode (PLZ/NPA) of the WORKPLACE. City minimum wages (e.g. Stadt Luzern) depend on it.

skill_level.description: Qualification of the worker, which sets the federal NAV wage tier: unskilled; experienced (4+ years in household work); eba (2-year federal vocational certificate); efz (3-year federal vocational diploma).

language.description: Language of the explanatory texts and of the clino.ch links: en, de, fr, it, es or pt. Default en.

annotations.title: Estimate employer cost and net wage

schaffhausen_sozialfonds.description: Schaffhausen only: employee share of the cantonal social fund (Sozialfonds, 0.04 % of the ALV wage).

schaffhausen_sozialfonds.description: Schaffhausen only: employer share of the cantonal social fund (Sozialfonds, 0.08 % of the ALV wage).

total_employer_cost.description: Gross wage + employer contributions + approximate admin fee of the compensation office. No service fee of any provider included.

admin_fee_of_contributions.description: The compensation office's admin fee rate for this annual wage, in % of the AHV/IV/EO contributions.

admin_fee_is_upper_bound.description: True where the office publishes only a ceiling of its wage-sum scale (Valais): the real rate can be lower.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the source that states the value.

what.description: What Clino prepares, in the requested language. The household signs, submits and pays itself.

tools.name: get_minimum_wage
tools.title: Minimum wage for household work
tools.description: The legal gross hourly minimum wage for household work (cleaning, childcare, care) at a Swiss workplace: federal NAV tiers by qualification, cantonal minimum wages (GE, NE, JU, TI, BS), city minimum wages (Stadt Luzern in force; Zürich and Winterthur voted, not yet in force) and the rule below 5 hours a week. Use it first for 'I want to hire...' questions.

tools.name: get_contract_terms
tools.title: Employment contract terms in one canton
tools.description: What the employment contract of a cleaner, nanny, carer or au pair in a Swiss private household has to say in one canton, from the canton's standard employment contract for household work (NAV / CTT / CNL) and the Code of Obligations: probation and its notice, notice after probation by service year, paid vacation weeks (by age), full-time week, overtime, night and Sunday supplements, paid public holidays, 13th month wage, hours register, maternity leave and sick pay in the first year. Every term carries its article and the instrument's verbatim sentence, and whether a written contract may deviate. Also what must be confirmed in writing (Art. 330b OR) and a link to Clino's free contract generator, prefilled with the figures given. Use it for 'write me an employment contract', 'what notice period applies', 'how many weeks of vacation', 'is overtime paid extra'.

canton.description: Swiss canton where the household lives: two-letter code (ZH, GE, VD...) or its name. The standard employment contract (NAV/CTT) of the WORKPLACE governs; that is this canton unless workplace_postcode places the work in another one.

lives_in.description: true if the worker lives in the household (board and lodging). Neuchâtel's standard contract only covers live-in staff, and Vaud gives them a longer notice.

hours_per_week.description: Average weekly hours, to prefill the contract generator.
